messages.subject: generating a statespace from polygon
parts:
Hi everyone,

 

I get asked fairly regularly if there is a way to create a statespace/habitat mask from an imported polygon. This is actually quite straightforward, and I have an example of doing exactly this in a (very early version of) bookdown that will eventually become a series of vignettes. The specific code is in section 4.2 of this document: https://bookdown.org/chrissuthy/SCR-design-book/. I stress this is a very early draft of a work in progress, but I figured section 4 (the only complete section) may be of some use.

 

Hope that helps!

 

Chris
